public_rationale: Contemporary evaluations found substantial weaknesses in understanding visual relationships across numerous leading models, including cases people handled readily. That supports the ordinary reading that important computer-vision problems remained unsolved. Strong segmentation and transfer results show substantial progress, but do not negate those gaps.
limitations: Vision-language evaluations test both image understanding and its connection to language.
The conclusion concerns substantial remaining problems, not a measurable percentage of progress toward solving vision.

statement.document_title: Reports of the birth of AGI are greatly exaggerated

from_speaker: the problem is still far from solved
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that substantial problems in general visual understanding remained, rather than that computer vision had made little progress.
The target is 2023 through the post date. Later improvements do not change this historical assessment.
Substantial gaps on ordinary visual relationships across multiple leading models count as unresolved problems. Occasional errors alone do not.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary evaluations show substantial, recurring weaknesses in important visual-understanding capabilities, including tasks people can readily perform.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporary evaluations demonstrate broadly robust visual understanding, with the remaining weaknesses confined to minor or exceptional cases.

evidence.locator: Section 5.3, evaluation of pretrained vision-language models
evidence.explanation: The evaluation of 17 pretrained CLIP models found substantial human–model gaps when captions swapped objects or attributes. Some object-replacement results approached human performance, but the broader composition weaknesses remained.

evidence.publisher: Kirillov et al., Meta AI Research, arXiv
evidence.explanation: Segment Anything demonstrated strong transfer on segmentation tasks, sometimes exceeding earlier supervised results. This qualifies any suggestion of little progress, but does not establish general visual understanding.
